name: Wizup for Woocommerce
author: wizupapp

sections.description:
Wizup integrates WooCommerce with WhatsApp messaging to streamline communication for order notifications, status updates, and abandoned cart recovery.

Features:

  • Send notifications for new orders
  • Notify customers when orders are delivered or cancelled
  • Recover abandoned carts with automated reminders
  • Add WhatsApp support buttons on product pages
  • Easy configuration of message templates
  • Full integration with WooCommerce order lifecycle

Third Party Service

This plugin relies on the external service Wizup API (https://wizup.app) to send WhatsApp messages.

  • Wizup Terms of Service
  • Wizup Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wizup-for-woocommerce/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Wizup-Plugin to configure settings
  4. Sign up at https://wizup.app and enter your API access token
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a subscription?

Yes, you need a Wizup account to use the API features. Visit wizup.app for more information.

How are message templates configured?

Message templates are configured in the Wizup dashboard and then selected in the plugin settings.
